veld-vo-druk-drie-fases.uitleg: Three teams of three. Red keeps the ball in the area, blue presses and yellow rests. Blue presses in three phases: first passively (track the play and close the passing lanes, no tackling), then blue may intercept, and finally full pressure. If blue wins the ball or the coach gives a signal, blue attacks the big goal straight away: 3v2 against two red players and the keeper. Then the roles rotate: blue keeps the ball, yellow presses, red rests.
veld-vo-druk-drie-fases.organisatie: On half a pitch. 16 × 14 m area about 38 m from goal; keeper in goal. Red (3) in the area, blue (3) with them, yellow (3) resting next to the area. Each phase about 1 minute; after an attack the next round starts in the area.
veld-vo-druk-drie-fases.meerSpelers: With more players: three teams of four (4v3 on goal), or a bigger area.
coachpunten: Passive pressing is still work: stay between ball and goal and close the short passing lane
Full pressure: the nearest player presses, the others shift across and close the passing lanes
After winning the ball go forward straight away: an attempt on goal within a few seconds

makkelijker: Bigger area, so red can keep the ball more easily
Only one red player defends the attack
moeilijker: Smaller area
The attack must be finished within 8 seconds
After losing the ball, all three red players may defend

veld-vo-drie-verdedigers.uitleg: Three against three, with the focus on the defenders’ jobs. The first defender presses the ball. The second covers: diagonally behind them, ready to step in if the attacker gets past. The third keeps the balance on the far side, a little deeper, watching the space behind the defence and their own player. When the ball is passed on, the roles change straight away: whoever is closest to the new ball carrier becomes the first defender. After winning the ball, the defenders can score on the two mini goals at the other end.
veld-vo-drie-verdedigers.organisatie: 26 × 32 m area with two mini goals at each short end. Red attacks (with the ball), blue defends. Swap roles after 5 attacks. The coach freezes play now and then to show the positions.
veld-vo-drie-verdedigers.meerSpelers: With more players: 4v4 (two covering, one in balance), or bring in a new three every round.
coachpunten: First defender: close down quickly, slow down for the last few metres and show the attacker outside
Second defender: 3–4 m diagonally behind the first, on the side the attacker wants to go
Third defender: in balance, a little deeper and narrower, with ball and player in view
Talk with every pass: who takes the ball, who covers?

makkelijker: Attackers start at walking pace
Narrower area (20 m)
moeilijker: Attackers already score by dribbling over the line
A fourth attacker as a joker
After winning the ball, score within 6 seconds

veld-vo-1-1-wegdrukken.uitleg: The defender passes the ball to the attacker at the other end and closes them down straight away. For the last few metres they slow down and drop into a side-on stance, just off the line to the middle. That leaves only the outside open and shows the attacker away towards the touchline. They stay an arm’s length away and only step in when the attacker pushes the ball too far ahead. The attacker scores by dribbling the ball over the line behind the defender.
veld-vo-1-1-wegdrukken.organisatie: 12 × 20 m channel. Defenders in a queue with balls at the scoring line, attackers in a queue at the other end. After each go, join the other queue.
coachpunten: Close down fast while the ball is travelling, short steps for the last few metres
Stand side-on, knees bent: inside closed, outside open
Watch the ball, not the feints
Only step in after a poor touch: otherwise keep showing them away

makkelijker: Narrower channel (8 m), so showing the attacker away is easier
Attacker at walking or dribbling pace only
moeilijker: Wider channel (16 m)
The attacker may also score in a mini goal
Defender starts 3 m further away

veld-vo-hoog-druk-loont.uitleg: A 5v5 game with keepers on a pitch split into three zones. A goal is worth more the higher up the pitch you won the ball: won in the last zone (near the opponents’ goal) and scored = 3 points, won in the middle zone = 2 points, won in your own half = 1 point. That way it pays to press straight away. In the example, red presses blue’s build-up and intercepts a back pass just in front of goal: 3 points.
veld-vo-hoog-druk-loont.organisatie: 36 × 48 m pitch split into three 16 m zones (disc cones or cones), with a youth goal and a keeper at each short end. Teams in bibs, 5-minute rounds.
veld-vo-hoog-druk-loont.meerSpelers: With more players: 6v6 or 7v7 on a bigger pitch.
coachpunten: Press as a team: the front player presses, the rest shift across and close the short passing lanes
Watch for the back pass: it is often soft and predictable
After winning the ball high up the pitch: finish straight away, don’t look round first

makkelijker: The keeper may not be pressed
Bigger pitch
moeilijker: Three touches maximum
A goal after winning the ball in the last zone only counts within 10 seconds
Smaller pitch

veld-vo-pressen-na-balverlies.uitleg: A 5v5 game on four mini goals. If you lose the ball, you have 5 seconds to win it back: manage it and your team gets a bonus point (and can try to score straight away). The coach counts down out loud. In the example, blue intercepts a pass, but two red players press together straight away, win the ball back and red scores.
veld-vo-pressen-na-balverlies.organisatie: 30 × 40 m pitch with two mini goals at each short end, 12 m apart. Teams in bibs, 4-minute rounds. Goal = 1 point, ball back within 5 seconds = 1 bonus point.
veld-vo-pressen-na-balverlies.meerSpelers: With more players: 6v6 on a bigger pitch, or a joker who always plays for the team in possession.
coachpunten: After losing the ball, no sulking but press straight away: the nearest player goes straight to the ball
Press in twos or threes, the rest close the short passing lanes
If it doesn’t work within 5 seconds: get back behind the ball quickly and stay compact

makkelijker: 8 seconds to win the ball back
Bigger pitch
moeilijker: 3 seconds
The other team already scores by keeping the ball for 5 passes
Two touches maximum

veld-vo-omschakelen-kaatsers.uitleg: A 5v5 game with keepers and two neutral bounce players on the touchlines. The bounce players play for the team in possession and may touch the ball twice at most. A normal goal is 1 point. Score within 10 seconds of winning the ball and it’s 2 points, and if the assist then comes from a bounce player, 3 points. In the example, red intercepts, plays straight into the bounce player, who lays it off first time to a player running through.
veld-vo-omschakelen-kaatsers.organisatie: 36 × 46 m pitch with a youth goal and a keeper at each short end. A bounce player (own colour) halfway along each touchline. Teams in bibs, 5-minute rounds; change the bounce players every round.
veld-vo-omschakelen-kaatsers.meerSpelers: With more players: 6v6 with bounce players, or four bounce players (two per touchline).
coachpunten: After winning the ball, look forward first: if the bounce player is free, play it in straight away
After the pass to the bounce player, run in behind straight away
The team that loses the ball: get back behind the ball immediately and close the middle

makkelijker: Bounce players may take three touches
15 seconds for the extra points
moeilijker: Bounce players one touch
8 seconds for the extra points
Goals only count after a pass from a bounce player

veld-vo-kantelen-blok.uitleg: Three attackers move the ball from side to side. Four defenders protect three gates together and move with the ball as one block: they shift across. The defender nearest the ball steps out and presses, the player next to them covers (diagonally behind) and the other two tuck inside, so the distances stay small. When the ball goes to the other side, the whole block shifts while the ball is travelling. The attackers score by passing the ball through a gate; if the defenders intercept, the point is theirs.
veld-vo-kantelen-blok.organisatie: 28 × 18 m area. Three 2.5 m gates on one long side, with four defenders in a line in front of them, about 5 m apart. Three attackers on the other side: left, centre and right. At first the attackers only play from side to side, so the defenders practise shifting; then they may pass through a gate. Swap after 2 minutes.
veld-vo-kantelen-blok.meerSpelers: With more players: four attackers against four defenders, or bring in a new back four every two minutes.
coachpunten: Shift while the ball is travelling, not when it arrives
The nearest player presses, the player next to them stands diagonally behind (cover)
Keep about 5 metres between you: never a pass between two defenders
The far-side defender leaves their side and tucks inside

makkelijker: The attackers play at walking pace and stop the ball each time
Side to side only, no scoring yet
moeilijker: A fourth attacker between the defenders and the gates
The attackers may also dribble through a gate
After winning the ball the defenders score in a mini goal at the other end

veld-vo-onderscheppen-passlijn.uitleg: Two passers play the ball to each other; a defender stands to the side between them. They read the pass, step in front at the right moment and play the ball first time into the mini goal. If it does not work, they reset for the next pass. After five attempts, change the defender.
veld-vo-onderscheppen-passlijn.organisatie: Passers 12 m apart, the defender 3 m to the side of the passing line. A mini goal 10 m behind the defender. Three players, one ball; take turns as defender.
coachpunten: Watch the passer’s hips and foot to see where the ball is going
Wait for the moment of the pass, then step in
Intercept with the foot closest to the mini goal

makkelijker: Defender stands closer to the passing line
Passers pass more softly
moeilijker: The passers may fake a pass
Two mini goals: score in the one on the side of the ball

veld-vo-sliding-blok.uitleg: The attacker dribbles towards the mini goal and shoots. The defender comes from the side and blocks the shot with a slide: low, leg stretched towards the ball and foot firm. Then the other way round. Practise this on a soft surface (grass) and never studs-up into the ball.
veld-vo-sliding-blok.organisatie: 15 × 12 m area with a mini goal. Pairs: the attacker dribbles from 12 m, the defender starts 4 m to the side. Walking pace first, then at speed. Swap after 4 goes.
coachpunten: Only slide as the shot comes, not before
Slide low along the ground with the leg nearest the ball
Always go for the ball, never the attacker’s ankles

makkelijker: Block standing up: step into the ball’s path and keep your foot firm
Attacker shoots softly
moeilijker: The attacker may fake a shot
Defender starts further away
After the block, win the ball and dribble away

veld-vo-druk-terugspeelbal.uitleg: The red team builds up from the keeper; blue waits patiently. Blue’s trigger is the backward pass: when a midfielder plays the ball back to a defender, blue’s striker sprints at them straight away, at an angle, so the pass back to the keeper is closed. The rest of blue push up and lock onto their player. If blue wins the ball, they score on the goal.
veld-vo-druk-terugspeelbal.organisatie: On half a pitch, 36 × 30 m, with a youth goal and keeper. Red: keeper, three defenders and a midfielder. Blue: four players. Swap roles after 5 attacks.
veld-vo-druk-terugspeelbal.meerSpelers: With more players: five against five with two midfielders, or red may score on two mini goals on the halfway line.
coachpunten: Wait for the trigger: the backward pass, not before
Striker: press at an angle so the keeper is shut out
All together: when one moves, the whole team moves

makkelijker: Red plays at walking pace
Red has one player fewer
moeilijker: Red may also play long to a target player
Blue must score within 6 seconds

veld-vo-duel-in-de-lucht.uitleg: The coach throws the ball high between two players. Both jump for the ball; whoever wins it heads it to their own partner. If that works, it is a point. Take off from one leg, use your arms to get up (not to push) and head the ball with your forehead.
veld-vo-duel-in-de-lucht.organisatie: Two pairs: the headers in the middle, their partners 8 m away on each side. The coach throws from 6 m. After 6 balls the headers swap with their partners. From U17; use a soft ball for players who are still learning.
coachpunten: Take a short run-up and jump off one leg
Arms up for balance, not against your opponent
Eyes open and head through the ball to your partner

makkelijker: Head without an opponent first
Lower throw
moeilijker: Head the ball into a mini goal
Ball from the side, like a cross

veld-vo-bewaker-schat.uitleg: There is a tall cone in a hoop: that is the treasure. You are the guard. The attacker dribbles round the hoop and tries to knock the cone over with a shot. Always stay between the ball and the cone. If the cone falls, swap roles.
veld-vo-bewaker-schat.organisatie: 10 × 10 m area with a hoop and a tall cone in the middle. Pairs, the attacker with a ball. Nobody may go into the hoop. Rounds of 45 seconds.
coachpunten: Watch the ball, not the other player’s feet
Small steps sideways, stay between the ball and the treasure
Low through your knees so you can move quickly

makkelijker: Bigger hoop, so the guard can stand closer
The attacker may only shoot softly
moeilijker: Two cones in two hoops
Two attackers against one guard

veld-vo-omschakelen-fluitje.uitleg: Four against four on two mini goals. On the whistle, the team with the ball leaves it, and the coach immediately plays a new ball in to the other team. Whoever was attacking now has to defend straight away; whoever was defending attacks straight away. Who switches the fastest?
veld-vo-omschakelen-fluitje.organisatie: 25 × 20 m pitch with a mini goal at each short end. Two teams of four. The coach stands on the touchline with balls and whistles every 20 to 40 seconds.
coachpunten: Turn round straight after the whistle: do not watch first
The nearest defender presses, the rest recover behind the ball
Attackers: play forward quickly while the others are not yet set

makkelijker: Only whistle when the ball is still
Three against three
moeilijker: The new ball is played in behind the defenders
A goal within 6 seconds of the whistle counts double

veld-vo-rugdekking.uitleg: Two against two. The first defender presses the ball. The second stands at an angle behind them, on the goal side, and gives cover: if the attacker gets past the first defender, the second steps in straight away. Then the roles change: whoever is closest to the ball becomes the first defender. After winning the ball, the defenders may score through the cone gate on the other side.
veld-vo-rugdekking.organisatie: 16 × 20 m area. Two mini goals behind the defenders, a cone gate on the other side. Attackers start with the ball; duels of 30 seconds. Swap after 4 attacks.
coachpunten: First defender: press, but do not dive in
Second defender: at an angle behind the first, 2–3 m away
Talk: "I’ve got you covered" and "go"

makkelijker: Narrower area
Attackers may only go one way
moeilijker: Bigger area
A third attacker who may join in

veld-vo-terugverdedigen.uitleg: The coach plays the ball long. The attacker starts a few metres ahead; the defender sprints back from behind. The aim: get between the ball and the goal as quickly as possible, and only then slow down and defend. If that works, the defender forces the attacker wide and blocks the shot. Then the roles change.
veld-vo-terugverdedigen.organisatie: On half a pitch with a keeper. The coach at the halfway line with balls, the attacker at 32 m, the defender 4 m behind. Swap after every attack.
coachpunten: Do not sprint to the ball, but to the space between ball and goal
Once goal-side: slow down, get low and force the attacker wide
Block with your body behind the ball, not with a loose foot

makkelijker: Defender starts closer to the attacker
No keeper, on a big goal
moeilijker: Defender starts further away
Attacker may also pass to a teammate

veld-vo-3-2-en-2-3-terug.uitleg: Three attackers play against two defenders on a goal with a keeper. After the shot (or if the defenders win the ball) play goes straight the other way: the two defenders attack the other goal, and the three attackers must get back as quickly as possible to defend. You practise using an overload and switching straight away.
veld-vo-3-2-en-2-3-terug.organisatie: 36 × 40 m area with two youth goals and keepers. Three red, two blue. After the second attack the next five start. After a save the keeper plays the ball straight out to a blue player.
coachpunten: Attackers: finish quickly, the overload does not last
Defenders after the switch: go forward straight away, do not wait
The keeper distributes quickly: the tempo is in the first pass

makkelijker: After a save red may first get back calmly
Smaller area
moeilijker: Finish within 8 seconds
A third blue player may join after the switch

veld-vo-vier-seconden.naam: Win it back in four seconds
veld-vo-vier-seconden.uitleg: Four against four on two mini goals. If you lose the ball, your team has four seconds to win it back. The coach counts down out loud. If you succeed and then score, your goal counts double. The players nearest the ball press together straight away; the rest close the passing lanes.
veld-vo-vier-seconden.organisatie: 28 × 22 m area with a mini goal at each short end. Two teams of four, the coach along the touchline. Rounds of 4 minutes.
veld-vo-vier-seconden.meerSpelers: With more players: 5v5 in a bigger area, or swap a team every round.
coachpunten: After losing the ball, switch straight away: do not sulk, hunt
Press in twos, from two sides
Not within four seconds? Get back behind the ball quickly

makkelijker: Six seconds
A joker who always helps defend
moeilijker: Three seconds
After winning it back, score within five seconds

veld-vo-ondertal-2-3.uitleg: Three attackers against two defenders. The defenders do not dive in, but drop back and hold the attackers up until the third defender has sprinted back: they start behind the attackers. Then it becomes three against three. The attackers try to score before that happens.
veld-vo-ondertal-2-3.organisatie: On half a pitch with a keeper. Attackers start at 32 m, the two defenders at 20 m, the third defender 6 m behind the attackers. After each attack everyone moves on one role.
coachpunten: Do not dive in: drop back and buy time
Close the middle together and force the attackers wide
Talk: say when the third defender is back

makkelijker: Third defender starts closer
Attackers three touches maximum
moeilijker: Third defender starts further away
Attackers must score within 8 seconds
